settings.heading: Materials and Standards
settings.content:
100% cotton, chosen for softness, breathability and everyday durability.

We pay attention to more than fibre composition. Our fabrics, dyes and finishing processes are selected against stringent quality and chemical-safety requirements (REACH standards), so what sits against the skin is considered as carefully as how the piece looks.

Made for frequent wear, regular washing and a long life in the wardrobe.

settings.heading: Easy Care Instructions
settings.content:
These pieces are designed for repeated wear and frequent washing.

Pre-treat stains when needed. Gentle machine wash with similar colours using a mild detergent. Do not bleach. Tumble dry as permitted by the garment care label, or dry in shade. Warm iron on the front or reverse as needed.

A little care helps preserve colour, shape and detailing so the piece can stay in rotation for longer.

settings.heading: Additional Information
settings.content: Tabi products are designed to address the impact of fast fashion on our environment. Each Tabi product is long lasting and sturdy, made with natural, biodegradable materials. No fabric is wasted, all leftovers are used in products made for our upcycle collection.

settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Our products are made to order and are shipped within 2 to 5 working days of receiving the order.

If your Tabi piece does not work for you, you can request an exchange or return within 5 days of delivery, no questions asked.

Please refer to Shipping, Exchanges & Returns policy for more details.

settings.heading: Made to order
settings.content:
Most pieces are cut and stitched only once you order them, in small batches, by a team we know by name.

It is why dispatch takes a few days longer than a warehouse would, and why very little of what we make goes unworn.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content:
Orders are dispatched within 2 to 5 working days. Delivery usually takes a further 3 to 7 working days depending on your pincode - use the pincode checker above for an estimate on this order.

Free shipping across India. Cash on delivery is available on most pincodes.

You will receive a tracking link by email and SMS as soon as your parcel leaves us.

settings.heading: Exchanges & returns
settings.content:
If your Tabi piece does not work for you, you can request an exchange or return within 5 days of delivery, no questions asked.

Pieces should be unworn and unwashed, with their tags on. Reverse pickup is arranged for you wherever our courier partners reach.

Please refer to our Shipping, Exchanges & Returns policy for full details.

settings.heading: A journey towards slower, mindful living.
settings.body: Tabi is a celebration of the everyday journey - yours and ours, together! It is built around the idea that the things we choose to live with can help us live a little more slowly and consciously. All Tabi products are built with love and care for the planet and the people using them, while blending the rich artisanal heritage of Indian handcrafts into everyday pieces.

settings.heading: Product
settings.lead: Made to be valued, worn often and kept.
settings.text: Natural fabrics, thoughtful design, comfort, craft and quality that make you want to reach for a piece again and again.

settings.heading: Process
settings.text: Small batches and made-to-order production help us create more intentionally and reduce unnecessary excess.

settings.heading: People
settings.text: We value the skill, time and hands behind every piece we make. This ensures the person behind the product is never the cheapest component.

settings.heading: Our three-part approach
settings.intro: Everything we make is viewed through three lenses.
